mapper.insert: INSERT INTO private_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, send_time, is_read) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT pm.*, su.nickname AS sender_nickname, su.avatar AS sender_avatar, ru.nickname AS receiver_nickname FROM private_message pm INNER JOIN user su ON pm.sender_id = su.id INNER JOIN user ru ON pm.receiver_id = ru.id WHERE (pm.sender_id = #{user1Id} AND pm.receiver_id = #{user2Id}) OR (pm.sender_id = #{user2Id} AND pm.receiver_id = #{user1Id}) ORDER BY pm.send_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM private_message WHERE (sender_id = #{user1Id} AND receiver_id = #{user2Id}) OR (sender_id = #{user2Id} AND receiver_id = #{user1Id})

SELECT pm.id, pm.sender_id, pm.receiver_id, pm.content, pm.send_time, pm.is_read, CASE WHEN pm.sender_id = #{userId} THEN ru.nickname ELSE su.nickname END AS other_nickname, CASE WHEN pm.sender_id = #{userId} THEN ru.avatar ELSE su.avatar END AS other_avatar, CASE WHEN pm.sender_id = #{userId} THEN pm.receiver_id ELSE pm.sender_id END AS other_id, COALESCE(unread_msg.unread, 0) AS unread_count FROM private_message pm INNER JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS other_user_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM private_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND NOT (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) latest ON pm.id = latest.max_id INNER JOIN user su ON pm.sender_id = su.id INNER JOIN user ru ON pm.receiver_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sender_id, COUNT(*) as unread FROM private_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY sender_id ) unread_msg ON unread_msg.sender_id = latest.other_user_id ORDER BY pm.send_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) FROM private_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND NOT (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{userId})
